description: demo section 4, one scheduler: yielding kernel worst 1ms-tick gap ~3.5ms vs ~2.2ms for a busy Elixir process (idle timer jitter ~2.3-2.9ms). ~1.5ms of compute per yield (1784 yields / ~900ms). Tune defk_tick: report timeslice usage more eagerly or yield after a fixed wall-clock budget. Done when the gap is comparable to the Elixir reference without measurable throughput loss.
title: Yielding kernel worst-case scheduler gap is above plain Elixir
